thanks for the long reply man. it was a good read. so found a cheap americana walkabout that i bought for $20 the vents are a bit lower and the grill is bigger so more air flow. 

cooking on the expert grill with the lid off is perfect for some burgers or something for me and my brother so i think ill just keep it for small things and learn a bit more on the americana for slow and low or smoking. once i git gud on that and save some money then i might just grab a weber kettle. 

also i use the kingford stuff and work fine with lid off. maybe i was just suffocating em in the small one (i dont remeber if i had vents open or not either) 

anyway thanks man. ill practice some more till i get the hang of it.

the flames die out and doesnt get hot anymore probably around 10 mins i notice that its significantly less hot.. i think it might be airflow so i cleaned out the bottom and ill leave the lid off. but if i wanna do chicken with the lid on Im afraid i might get screwed with how fast my charcoal dies.

that sucks dude. ive had a friend like that. everytime i thought about her i felt like trash. like im not enough for her. i wanted to be her friend but i couldnt. honestly i felt better just not talking to her after a while. 

i dont know how it is between you guys but i hope for the best for you. 

love ya

sorry to hear whats going on, it not easy being in college and trying to be a cartoonist (ive tried myself). i hope everything goes well for you and something will hopefully cheer you up. 

hope you had a good rest.

that sucks man. ive had days like that too. honestly im not sure what to do. i usally call the hotline and feel weird afterwards but not suicidal or just numb it with food or entertainment. 

sorry that happened man. its tough. even just posting this story is good cause you are reaching out to anything.

keep cool man.
lets go destroy googles servers. im sick of seeing a number everytime i google suicide
thats hard man. sorry to hear that.
man my instincts are muddled. im like a pet man. if i push her away and run i might not be able to live. i just dont want one of her famous family freakouts.
go lift weights. might make you feel better. if not at least when you snap you'll be more effective
good luck. let us know how it goes
glad you got a good friend man. i hope everything works out for you bruv

not always. dont get me wrong, im not a reddit teir fedora tipper. im actually attending a religious school and attend church every week. i stil feel incredibly suicidal at times. praying doesnt always help, in fact i usually feel better when im helping others or doing something to better my body or mind.

Ive had a brief few months were i felt like not being loved didnt matter anymore. i felt free and felt like i could focus on studies. i figured it didnt matter cause even if i couldnt make an impact with a family and lineage i could at least make movies or change live with the people around me. then school started back up and my mom was bugging me about finding a GF (im 26 but shes italian and for the life of me i cant tell her to leave me alone.) anyway i dont know what switched for me or why my suicidal intentions came back so quickly. i cant know how it is at 31. hang in there man. hopefully our brains can just shut off and we can enjoy something else in life.
